title: Whose Button Is This?
summary: Tiny Tim, a little toy robot, sets off on a journey down the street to return a lost button. Along the way he discovers new things, is saved at the very last moment, and makes a friend.
pages: Tiny Tim was sitting on the road when suddenly a button bounced up to him.

"I wonder where it came from," he said.
He wanted to find out.

The side of the road was very busy.
"Whoa!"
He was nearly stepped on.

Luckily he managed to dodge out of the way.
"It's scary out here," he said.

The green man didn't answer. He just turned red.
"What a rude man."

Tiny Tim kept looking.
"Whose button is this?"

"I have to get to the other side.
I'm sure that's where it came from."

SPLASH!
"That was close."
He waited for the cars to go by, and only then did he go on.

Maybe she's the one he's looking for.
"Hello, who are you?"
"I'm Ruby Rags." "I think this is yours," he said.
"Thank you, little robot. Would you like to be friends?"
